mainText: This is Dose of Good for Tuesday, November 10. Here are 5 good news stories. First: Brazilian scientists turn landfill leachate into fertiliser as good as the commercial kind. Unicamp researchers recovered potassium, nitrogen and phosphorus-rich minerals from a Campinas landfill. In lettuce trials the fertiliser matched or beat commercial NPK, with no detectable heavy metals. Second: 12-year-old ballerina from a Rio favela wins a scholarship to dance in the US. Fernanda Rosa won a full scholarship to the Oklahoma Ballet School after performing at YAGP Brazil. She trains at ViDançar, a project serving over 400 people in the Maré favelas. Third: More than 27,000 orchids saved from a road project in India. Researchers moved the orchids from trees due to be felled in Kerala and replanted them. After one to two years about 71% were alive, and some have produced seeds. Fourth: Dog that fled a storm and hid in a car wash is adopted by Brasília's police. Bacco was found inside a car in Candangolândia and now lives with the 25th Military Police Battalion, where he is settling in. Fifth: A robot assembles a structure in orbit on its own for the first time. In Caltech's ASTRA mission, an autonomous robot fitted truss modules together in space without astronauts, a step toward building antennas and stations in orbit. That was your dose for today. See you tomorrow!
